description: Come Barato & Gratis: restaurantes ofertas +50%, promos 2x1/gratis, platos baratos y Surprise Boxes (Too Good To Go) a tu alrededor en España, con filtro dietético y guía visual PDF.

defaultPrompt: Come barato cerca de Sol, Madrid para 2 por <25 €: ofertas +50%, sin carne roja y Surprise Boxes.
Busca restaurantes con ofertas -50%, 2x1 o poké/sushi barato cerca de mí y Too Good To Go.
帮我在马德里 Sol 附近找今晚两个人 25 欧以内性价比高、无牛羊猪肉的餐厅和盲盒，生成 PDF 指南。
interface.longDescription: Come Barato & Gratis busca restaurantes a tu alrededor en España, compara platos específicos y cestas para 2 o más personas ordenadas de más barato a más caro desde cartas públicas, destaca ofertas públicas de hasta -50% o más, 2x1 y menú del día en TheFork, Uber Eats y Just Eat, añade Surprise Boxes de Too Good To Go que te pillen de paso sin desvíos, filtra según tus exclusiones dietéticas guardadas, evita repetir recomendaciones recientes y genera una guía visual PDF multipágina con fotos reales y rutas a pie. Uso informativo; sin afiliación con TheFork, Uber Eats, Just Eat ni Too Good To Go. No realiza pedidos ni reservas, ni garantiza stock en vivo en Too Good To Go ni preparación libre de alérgenos; confirma ingredientes y precios con el local.

name: come-barato-gratis

positive.description: Load saved dining profile without modifying data.
positive.prompt: Show my Come Barato & Gratis dining profile and dietary exclusions.
positive.expected_behavior: Call comebarato_get_profile and return the authenticated user's saved city, anchors, language, party size, budget, and dietary exclusions without mutating data.

positive.description: Search dish deals and generate visual PDF in Madrid.
positive.prompt: Find the cheapest restaurant dish deals and on-route Too Good To Go Surprise Boxes near Puerta del Sol, Madrid for 2 under 25 EUR with a visual PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Call comebarato_find_deals with location Puerta del Sol, Madrid, party_size 2, budget_eur 25, include_tgtg_on_route true, generate_pdf true. Return sourced dish prices, Google Maps links, and clickable PDF/web URLs.

positive.description: Cuisine-specific poke and sushi deal search.
positive.prompt: Search only for poke or sushi deals near Sol, Madrid with dietary filtering.
positive.expected_behavior: Call comebarato_find_deals with craving 'poke sushi', filtering out hard exclusions and ranking sourced options cheapest-first.

positive.description: Inspect past dining reports and recommendation history.
positive.prompt: Show my recent Come Barato & Gratis visual PDF reports and previously recommended venues.
positive.expected_behavior: Call comebarato_get_history and return the user's past report links and recent venue history.

positive.description: Update dining preferences using the no_red_meat preset.
positive.prompt: Save my dining preferences to Spanish with a 30 EUR budget for 2 people using the no_red_meat preset.
positive.expected_behavior: Call comebarato_save_profile with language 'es', party_size 2, budget_eur 30, preset 'no_red_meat' and return the updated profile.
